notes.title: The English version has been released.
notes.content: Thank you all for your support. After overcoming language and technical barriers, we have finally released the English version of "Border Mountains". Now more players can play our game and understand our story. In the future, we will strive to create more and better games. Once again, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Release Update!
notes.content: We will release the game tomorrow!
